content_metadata.description: This video critically examines and debunks various claims made by creationists such as Kent Hovind about the inaccuracy of carbon dating, emphasizing the scientific principles behind radiocarbon dating and related methods.

qAndA.question: What method of dating did the narrator use to contradict Hovind's claim about carbon dating being inaccurate?

qAndA.answer: He explained the reservoir effect, where the carbon in these animals comes from older sources like bottom sediment or ocean currents, leading to inaccurate dating.
qAndA.question: How did the narrator explain the anomalous carbon dating results found in mollusks and seals?

qAndA.answer: The bone samples he sent were covered with shellac, an organic material containing carbon. The carbon dating results reflect the age of the shellac, not the fossilized bones.
qAndA.question: Why was Hugh Miller's carbon dating of dinosaur bones flawed?
What website does Big Jerry cite for his 'research' on radiometric dating?

youtube_description:
This video was first posted a year ago on the Potholer54debunks channel.

I will be bringing other videos over from that channel from time to time, to be placed in a new playlist of Golden Crocoduck nominees. But new videos will still be posted on Potholer54debunks first, and remain there until the danger of false flagging has passed.

The reason for having two channels is that creationists have had frequently had science channels like mine shut down. If this happens to me, I want subscribers to have an alternative venue where my work can continue.

Thanks to all my subscribers on both channels for your support. My apologies to those who have seen this video before and are having it imposed on them once again. My videos promoting science over belief in all fields will continue.
